Policies and Initiatives.title: UP govt scraps  ₹25,000 crore MoU with Bengaluru-based Puch AI citing credibility concerns
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Uttar Pradesh has cancelled a ₹25,000 crore MoU with Bengaluru-based Puch AI due to financial credibility concerns. The decision was made after a review process found the startup unable to meet necessary financial requirements. The agreement was terminated to maintain integrity in governance.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Digi push: Govt allocates Rs 225cr for UP AI Mission
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Indian government has allocated Rs 225 crore for the UP AI Mission, a significant investment in the state's digital push. This allocation aims to promote artificial intelligence in Uttar Pradesh, driving technological advancements and innovation. The funding is expected to support various AI-related initiatives and projects in the region.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Govt signs MoU with ARF for AI-driven urban governance
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Odisha's housing department has partnered with IIT Kanpur's AIRAWAT Research Foundation to enhance urban governance through artificial intelligence. The collaboration aims to leverage AI for better urban planning and service delivery, and an AI Project Management Unit will be established. This initiative will create a multi-year AI roadmap for Odisha's urban development goals.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Uttar Pradesh Budget 2026-27: From ‘AI Mission’ to ‘U-Hub’, how govt plans to boost jobs for youth
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has announced plans to launch an "AI Mission" and "U-Hub" initiative in its 2026-27 budget to boost job creation for youth. The initiatives aim to promote artificial intelligence and entrepreneurship, respectively, to generate employment opportunities. The government hopes to leverage these programs to drive economic growth and development in the state.

The event coincided with the conclusion of the Federated Intelligence Hackathon, which focused on health AI. The deliberations aimed to shape the development of health AI in a responsible and innovative manner.

Policies and Initiatives.title: UP govt to host AI-led innovation, skills conference in Lucknow
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government will host an AI-led innovation and skills conference in Lucknow, bringing together global technology majors. Companies such as Microsoft, Google, TCS, and Intel are set to participate in the event. The conference aims to promote AI-led innovation and skills development in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: Pay or go viral: UP woman blackmailed using AI-generated obscene photos; Cyber cafe operator, brother booked
Major AI Developments.summary: A 25-year-old woman in Uttar Pradesh was blackmailed using AI-generated obscene photos by a cyber cafe operator and his brother, who extorted Rs 50,000 from her. The brothers threatened to upload the morphed photos online if their demands were not met, and later targeted the woman's husband. The police have booked the brothers and suspect they may have blackmailed other women as well.

Major AI Developments.title: UP using AI & Swiss tech for building quality e-ways
Major AI Developments.summary: The state of Uttar Pradesh is utilizing artificial intelligence and Swiss technology to construct high-quality expressways. This initiative aims to improve the construction process and ensure the durability of the roads. The use of AI and Swiss technology is expected to enhance the overall quality of the expressways being built.

Major AI Developments.title: UP eyes deep-tech leadership, CM Yogi pushes time-bound innovation roadmap
Major AI Developments.summary: The state of Uttar Pradesh aims to become a leader in deep technology, with a focus on areas such as AI, quantum, green hydrogen, and drones. A time-bound innovation roadmap has been pushed by Chief Minister Yogi to drive this initiative. The Noida hub and an IIT Kanpur-led ecosystem will play key roles in scaling and promoting global outreach.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘Need to connect schoolkids with AI, empower teachers’
Major AI Developments.summary: There is a need to connect school children with Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance their learning experience. Empowering teachers with the necessary skills and knowledge to effectively integrate AI in the classroom is also crucial. This integration aims to improve the education system and prepare students for the future.

Major AI Developments.title: The UKSC’s “Any Hardware” Shortcut: Why Emotional Perception AI Raises More Questions Than It Answers — And Why India’s Framework Does Better
Major AI Developments.summary: The UK Supreme Court's decision in Emotional Perception AI Limited v Comptroller General of Patents has changed how subject-matter eligibility questions for computer programs are evaluated. The judgment introduces a new test, but the court chose not to apply it, and contains errors of reasoning. In contrast, India's framework for evaluating similar issues is considered more effective.

Major AI Developments.title: Crisil, IIT-K join hands for AI research systems

Major AI Developments.summary: Lucknow University is introducing new BCA and MSc programmes in artificial intelligence and cyber security. Major AI Developments.title: ‘AI not just a wave, but here to reshape careers’
Major AI Developments.summary: Artificial intelligence is not just a passing trend, but a transformative force that will reshape various careers. AI is expected to have a significant impact on the job market, changing the way industries operate and creating new opportunities. The integration of AI will require workers to adapt and acquire new skills to remain relevant in the changing career landscape.

Major AI Developments.title: High-resolution cameras, AI helped track culprits who threw stones at Vande Bharat train: Vaishnaw
Major AI Developments.summary: High-resolution cameras and AI technology installed in a Vande Bharat train helped authorities identify and catch individuals who threw stones at the train in Uttar Pradesh. Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw disclosed this information in the Lok Sabha, highlighting the train's advanced safety features. The technology enabled successful tracking of the culprits in the Muzaffarnagar area.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘Indianised database must for efficacy of AI tools’
Major AI Developments.summary: Experts emphasize the need for an Indianised database to ensure the efficacy of AI tools, as current databases are largely based on Western data. This is crucial for AI tools to effectively understand and process Indian languages, accents, and cultural nuances. An Indianised database would enable AI tools to provide more accurate and relevant results for Indian users.

Major AI Developments.title: 8 data centre parks to turn into digital, AI hub
Major AI Developments.summary: Eight data centre parks are set to be transformed into a digital and AI hub, marking a significant development in the tech industry. This transformation is expected to have a major impact on the area's technological landscape.

Major AI Developments.title: LU expands AI courses to all depts

Major AI Developments.title: Constems AI Systems raises $2 Mn led by Finvolve and India Accelerator
Major AI Developments.summary: Constems AI Systems has raised $2 million in a pre-Series A funding round co-led by Finvolve and India Accelerator. The round also saw participation from existing investors, including Cognify, AIF, and Inflection Point Ventures. The funds will be used to drive product innovation, global deployments, and expansion into new markets, including Southeast Asia, Japan, and the Middle East.

Major AI Developments.title: UP CM Yogi to launch IBM AI GovTech Innovation Centre in Lucknow today

The centre will prioritize Generative AI and Agentic AI, developing solutions for government and enterprise use cases. The launch is scheduled to take place today.

Major AI Developments.title: ‘AI, strong primary healthcare must for affordable med facility’
Major AI Developments.summary: Artificial intelligence and strong primary healthcare are essential for providing affordable medical facilities. A robust primary healthcare system, combined with AI, can help make medical care more accessible and cost-effective. Major AI Developments.title: UP inks MoU for 1GW AI hub in YEIDA; operations to start by 2028
Major AI Developments.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to establish a 1GW AI hub in the Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority (YEIDA) area. The project aims to start operations by 2028, with the hub expected to drive growth and innovation in the region. The initiative is part of the state's efforts to promote artificial intelligence and technology development.

Major AI Developments.title: AM group, Invest UP sign MoU to set up $25 billion AI data centre in Uttar Pradesh
Major AI Developments.summary: The AM group and Invest UP have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to establish a $25 billion AI data centre in Uttar Pradesh. The Yeida authority has allotted 289 acres of land for the project, which will be a 1 GW carbon-free facility. The data centre aims to reach full operational capacity by 2030.

AI Start-Up News.title: DAAKit raises $138K in pre-seed round led by Inflection Point Ventures
AI Start-Up News.summary: DAAKit, a hyperlocal fulfillment and last-mile logistics startup, has raised $138K in a pre-seed funding round led by Inflection Point Ventures. The funds will be used to expand operations, launch new dark stores, and strengthen its technology infrastructure and team. DAAKit was founded in 2024 and operates an asset-light logistics model, currently serving cities including Delhi, Gurugram, and Mumbai.
